learning_outcomes.text: After completing the course, the student shall have knowledge of and be able to use the most common methods for demand models and demand forecasting methods.

After completing the course, the student shall have knowledge of planning concepts and be able to apply methods for designing production systems and be able to use the most common methods in sales- and operations planning.
After completing the course, the student shall have knowledge of and be able to use the most common methods in master planning, material planning and detailed planning.
After completing the course, the student shall have knowledge of and be able to use the most common methods for inventory management.

assessment_rules: Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course. The grading scale is U, 3, 4, 5.
bibliography: Olhager, Jan, (2013) Produktionsekonomi : principer och metoder för utformning, styrning och utveckling av industriell produktion ISBN: 9789144067667 Lund : Studentlitteratur, 2013
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
